en.quote: And it shall come to pass, if they say unto thee, Whither shall we go forth? then thou shalt tell them, Thus saith the LORD; Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sword, to the sword; and such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for the captivity, to the captivity.
en.riddle: Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sword, to the sword
en.speaker: the LORD

he.quote: וְהָיָה כִּֽי-יֹאמְרוּ אֵלֶיךָ אָנָה נֵצֵא וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם כֹּֽה-אָמַר יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר לַמָּוֶת לַמָּוֶת וַאֲשֶׁר לַחֶרֶב לַחֶרֶב וַאֲשֶׁר לָֽרָעָב לָֽרָעָב וַאֲשֶׁר לַשְּׁבִי לַשֶּֽׁבִי
he.riddle: אֲשֶׁר לַמָּוֶת לַמָּוֶת וַאֲשֶׁר לַחֶרֶב לַחֶרֶב
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי
